info.headline: Notify NYC - Exercise
info.description:
Notification issued 10-16-2026 at 04:27 PM.
The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey will conduct a training exercise between 8:00 AM and 1:00 PM on Saturday, 10/17, at JFK Airport in Queens. Airport operations will not be affected, though travelers and members of the public may see smoke and a presence of emergency personnel and vehicles at and around the airport. This is only a drill.
